S1-R8.what_changed: Adds: the documents of an open customer or vendor may all arrive from the server in one request; the rule sets only how many are shown at a time.
S1-R8.v11: A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices, an open customer or vendor shows its first 100 documents, then the next 100 as the user scrolls; its document count, its subtotals, the Totals row and the exports always cover all of its documents.
S1-R8.v13: A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices, an open customer or vendor shows its first 100 documents, then the next 100 as the user scrolls; its document count, its subtotals, the Totals row and the exports always cover all of its documents. The documents of an open customer or vendor may all arrive from the server in one request; this rule sets only how many are shown at a time.

S5-E3.what_changed: Adds: if none of the ticked locations is in the new list and the new list holds only one location, the chip is hidden (S5-N1) instead of reading "Location: All locations".
S5-E3.v11: Changing the as-of date keeps every ticked location that is still in the new list (S5-R3). If none of the ticked locations is still in the list, the filter returns to All locations, and the chip reads "Location: All locations". A user who chose No locations keeps No locations.
S5-E3.v13: Changing the as-of date keeps every ticked location that is still in the new list (S5-R3). If none of the ticked locations is still in the list, the filter returns to All locations, and the chip reads "Location: All locations", unless the new list holds only one location, in which case the chip is hidden (S5-N1). A user who chose No locations keeps No locations.

S8-R3.what_changed: Adds one exception, as today: on A/P Unpaid Invoices a vendor's group row does not wrap, so a very long vendor name (78 characters still fit) can make the table scroll sideways at 1440 pixels.
S8-R3.v11: The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns) and A/P Unpaid Invoices, column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.
S8-R3.v13: The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns) and A/P Unpaid Invoices, column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column. One exception, as today: on A/P Unpaid Invoices a vendor's group row does not wrap, so a very long vendor name (78 characters still fit) can make the table scroll sideways at 1440 pixels.
